title: Women's Retro – Loose Goose Embroidered Zip Hoodie

headline: LOOSE
inks: amber and cream on Black and Navy, burnt orange and navy on Ash
chest: a small strutting goose with one foot raised

gift_line: for the friend who skates like nobody is watching.
seo_desc: A goose zip up hoodie: LOOSE GOOSE on the back around a roller-skating goose in a headband, plus an embroidered strutting goose on the chest.
